import primitive_api as api

ctx = api.get_task_context()
obs = api.observe()
print("Context:", ctx)
print("Initial Pose:", obs.get("agent"))
print("Initial Visible:", [o.get("objectId") for o in obs.get("visible_objects", [])])

# Scan the scene first to populate visual memory and see what objects/receptacles exist
scan = api.scan_scene(queries=["Book", "Magazine", "Newspaper", "Bed", "Table", "SideTable", "Desk", "CoffeeTable"], rotations=4, include_tilts=True, remember=True)
print("Scan query hits:", {k: [x.get("objectId") for x in v] for k, v in scan.get("query_hits", {}).items()})
print("All seen types:", sorted(list({o.get("objectType") for o in scan.get("all_seen", [])})))
for o in scan.get("all_seen", []):
    if any(k in (o.get("objectType", "") + o.get("objectId", "")).lower() for k in ["book", "news", "bed", "table", "desk", "stand", "dresser", "shelf"]):
        print("Seen candidate:", o.get("objectId"), o.get("objectType"), "dist:", o.get("distance"))

print("Progress:", api.check_progress_public())

steps.code:
import primitive_api as api

print("Pose:", obs_after["observation"]["agent"])
print("Visible:", [(o["objectId"], o["objectType"], o["distance"]) for o in obs_after["visible_objects"]])

# Move further in -x direction so we clear the bed completely
api.rotate("right")
for i in range(4):
    r = api.move_ahead()
    print(f"Move {i+1} (-x):", r.get("lastActionSuccess"), r.get("errorMessage"))
    if not r.get("lastActionSuccess"):
        break

api.rotate("left")
# Now move ahead towards the small table (SideTable) in -z direction
for i in range(6):
    obs_cur = api.observe()
    vis_ids = [o["objectId"] for o in obs_cur["visible_objects"]]
    print(f"Before move {i+1} (-z), pose={obs_cur['agent']['position']}, vis={vis_ids}")
    if any("SideTable" in oid or "Table" in oid for oid in vis_ids):
        for o in obs_cur["visible_objects"]:
            if "Table" in o["objectType"]:
                print("Found table:", o["objectId"], "dist:", o["distance"])
    r = api.move_ahead()
    if not r.get("lastActionSuccess"):
        print("Blocked moving -z:", r.get("errorMessage"))
        break

obs_end = api.inspect_current_view(label="at_small_table", remember=True)
print("End pose:", obs_end["observation"]["agent"])
print("End visible:", [(o["objectId"], o["objectType"], o["distance"], o["receptacle"]) for o in obs_end["visible_objects"]])

import primitive_api as api

# In the previous cell, we checked r.get("lastActionSuccess") which was None because StepResult uses r.get("ok")!
# Look at the image: the nightstand is right there at x ~ -1.1, z ~ -2.0!
# Right now we are at x=-0.75, z=-0.5, facing y=180 (-z).
# We need to move one more step in -x (so x=-1.0 or -1.25) to be in the aisle between the bed and the wall, then walk forward in -z!

api.rotate("right")  # now facing y=270 (-x)
for i in range(2):
    r = api.move_ahead()
    print(f"Step -x {i+1}: ok={r.get('ok')}, err={r.get('error')}")

api.rotate("left")  # now facing y=180 (-z)
for i in range(6):
    r = api.move_ahead()
    obs_cur = api.observe()
    vis = [(o["objectId"], o["objectType"], o["distance"], o["receptacle"]) for o in obs_cur["visible_objects"]]
    print(f"Step -z {i+1}: ok={r.get('ok')}, pos={obs_cur['agent']['position']}, vis={vis}")
    if any("SideTable" in o["objectType"] or "Table" in o["objectType"] or "Dresser" in o["objectType"] for o in obs_cur["visible_objects"] if o["distance"] <= 1.5):
        break
    if not r.get("ok"):
        break

obs_now = api.inspect_current_view(label="near_nightstand", remember=True)
print("Current view visible:", [(o["objectId"], o["objectType"], o["distance"], o["receptacle"]) for o in obs_now["visible_objects"]])

import primitive_api as api

# In the previous cell, we checked `if not r.get("ok"): break` and `r.get("ok")` was None!
# Let's see what keys `r` has!
r = api.move_ahead()
print("StepResult keys:", list(r.keys()))
print("Position after 1 step:", api.observe()["agent"]["position"])

# Keep walking forward in -z towards the nightstand (which is dead ahead in the image!)
for i in range(5):
    prev_pos = api.observe()["agent"]["position"]
    r = api.move_ahead()
    obs_cur = api.observe()
    cur_pos = obs_cur["agent"]["position"]
    vis = [(o["objectId"], o["objectType"], o["distance"], o["receptacle"]) for o in obs_cur["visible_objects"]]
    print(f"Step {i+2}: pos={cur_pos}, vis={vis}")
    if cur_pos == prev_pos:
        print("Stopped moving at:", cur_pos)
        break

# Let's check visible objects now (and maybe look down if needed)
obs_cur = api.observe()
for o in obs_cur["visible_objects"]:
    print("Visible object:", o["objectId"], o["objectType"], "dist:", o["distance"], "receptacle:", o["receptacle"])

# If SideTable is visible, put the held book on it!
inv = api.query_inventory()
print("Inventory:", inv)
if inv:
    held_id = inv[0]["objectId"]
    # Check if any Table/SideTable/Dresser is visible
    tables = [o for o in obs_cur["visible_objects"] if o["receptacle"] and o["objectType"] != "Bed"]
    if not tables:
        api.look("down")
        obs_cur = api.observe()
        tables = [o for o in obs_cur["visible_objects"] if o["receptacle"] and o["objectType"] != "Bed"]
        print("After look down, visible:", [(o["objectId"], o["objectType"], o["distance"], o["receptacle"]) for o in obs_cur["visible_objects"]])
    for t in tables:
        put_res = api.put_object(held_id, t["objectId"])
        print("Put on", t["objectId"], "result:", put_res.get("observation_after", {}).get("lastActionSuccess"), put_res.get("observation_after", {}).get("errorMessage"))
        if api.check_success().get("success"):
            break

print("Check success:", api.check_success())
print("Progress:", api.check_progress_public())

import primitive_api as api

# Look at repl_turn_5_6648f8dd3b.png: at z=-2.0 with cameraHorizon=30, we are too close to the wall so the top of SideTable is below our field of view (hence "No valid positions to place object found"!).
# Let's first try looking down at z=-2.0, and if that still fails, step back 1 step to z=-1.75 (where in repl_turn_4_4d9d9418f9.png / Step 4 the top of the SideTable was clearly in view!) and try putting there!

held_id = "Book|+00.06|+00.56|-01.21"
side_table_id = "SideTable|-01.20|+00.01|-02.47"

api.look("down")
obs1 = api.observe()
print("At z=-2.0 horizon=60 vis:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in obs1["visible_objects"]])
r1 = api.put_object(held_id, side_table_id)
print("Put at z=-2.0 horizon=60:", r1["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r1["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])

if not api.check_success().get("success"):
    # Restore horizon to 30, step back to z=-1.75 or z=-1.5
    api.look("up")
    api.rotate("left")
    api.rotate("left")  # facing +z (0 deg)
    api.move_ahead()    # now at z=-1.75
    api.rotate("left")
    api.rotate("left")  # facing -z (180 deg)
    obs2 = api.observe()
    print("At z=-1.75 horizon=30, pos:", obs2["agent"]["position"], "vis:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in obs2["visible_objects"]])
    r2 = api.put_object(held_id, side_table_id)
    print("Put at z=-1.75 horizon=30:", r2["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r2["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])

if not api.check_success().get("success") and api.query_inventory():
    api.look("down")
    obs3 = api.observe()
    print("At z=-1.75 horizon=60, vis:", [(o["objectId"], o["distance"]) for o in obs3["visible_objects"]])
    r3 = api.put_object(held_id, side_table_id)
    print("Put at z=-1.75 horizon=60:", r3["observation_after"]["lastActionSuccess"], r3["observation_after"]["errorMessage"])

print("Check success:", api.check_success())
print("Progress:", api.check_progress_public())
